publication_blockers.reason: The SkillCorner repository MIT license clearly covers code and documentation, but the license scope for core tracking data and row-level derivatives remains unresolved.
No FPD row-level artifact is currently distributable. No FileObject or FileSet can truthfully describe an FPD dataset download.
No FPD content release has been published; no publication date is assigned.
Final FPD dataset creator and authorship roles have not been approved; no creator identity is asserted.
The observation RecordSet is a conceptual schema without row-level FPD files. An upstream URL alone would not express the canonical measurement transform as a supported Croissant extraction.
